entries.title: Unknown field in segment builder
entries.root_cause: The segment builder accesses `span` on `ThreadSegment`, but that type has no such field.

entries.title: Unknown field in spool formatter
entries.root_cause: The spool formatter accesses `shade` on `SpoolLabel`, but that type has no such field.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both are Rust E0609 field errors, but they affect different types and require changes to different field accesses.

entries.title: Unavailable reedframe version
entries.root_cause: The reedframe requirement `^0.9` has no matching version in the searched crates.io index.

entries.title: Unavailable shuttletree version
entries.root_cause: The shuttletree requirement `^0.6` has no matching version in the searched crates.io index.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both are Cargo version selection errors, but a different dependency requirement must be corrected.
